careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: Build with a team that ships.
careers.empty: No open roles right now — check back soon.
careers.closed: This role is no longer accepting applications.
careers.heroBody: At Fekra, every success is shared, every voice matters, and every person belongs.
careers.why1Body: You own features end to end — architecture, build, review, release. Nobody hands you a spec and walks away.
careers.why2Body: We plan realistically and ship weekly. No heroics, no permanent crunch, no surprise weekends.
careers.why3Body: An annual learning budget, senior engineers who review your work properly, and a path that is written down.
careers.why4Body: Clients across Egypt, the Gulf, Europe and the US — so the problems stay varied and the standards stay high.
careers.step1Body: We read every application ourselves and reply either way, usually within three working days.
careers.step2Body: Thirty minutes with a recruiter to talk through your experience and answer your questions about us.
careers.step3Body: A working session with two engineers. No whiteboard puzzles — we talk about real problems.
careers.step4Body: References, a written offer, and a start date that works for your notice period.
careers.noFitBody: We hire continuously and roles open every month. Send us your CV and we will reach out when something matches.
careers.applyAside: Applying takes about five minutes. We reply to every application.
